result.rationale: CIP says Helax is wholly owned by CIP-managed funds and names CI Growth Markets Fund II and Copenhagen Infrastructure Energy Transition Fund I. Equity and both funds are verified. Correct the record because Helax remained pre-development/under review and its hydrogen concept was reportedly changed to electricity generation with withdrawal from the Ciudad Ixtepec award process. No project capital commitment, current concession, final permit, offtake, FID, financial close, construction or operation was verified.
